scope: Standalone CPU frozen-field algebraic screening with actual project Wendland and matrix-inverse headers. No JSph interaction/outer loop, state evolution, periodic clone, wall, production switch or implementation acceptance.
planned_outputs: tests/outputs/upl_p3_pair_Debug_r1_run and Release_r1_run; nodes.csv, pair_summary.csv, rates.csv, summary.csv, complete.json. Tests/logs contains separate immutable build/run/check receipts. Execution still requires root review.

geometry.jitter: Regular and deterministic one-axis dyadic perturbation; each displacement magnitude exactly dp/8 in jittered patch, no periodic ghosts
geometry.J: Frozen heterogeneous (28+hash%9)/32, range[.875,1.125], not a generated deformation trajectory
geometry.volume: Vi=dp^dimension*Ji; same frozen Vi used in both directed contributions
geometry.C: Inverse of sum_j -Vj dij tensor grad_iW; full inverse3D or xz block2D, no singular fallback
geometry.core: Reference index abs<=1 per active axis,9/27 full-support nodes; support plus two jitter radii stays within retained patch. Truncated outer layers are reported separately.

material_and_units.gamma_note: Positive reference specific weight rho_water*8 used for conductivity units. Signed manufactured body gravity varies0/-8/+8 m/s2 independently; it does not reset this denominator or make it zero.
material_and_units.Ace_m_s2: Solver-style acceleration excluding explicit body gravity
material_and_units.dimension2_volume: Area per unit out-of-plane thickness; budget units m^dimension/s

operators.name: legacy_symC_head_plus_receiverC_Das
operators.head: H_ij=pi-pj-rho_water*g dot dij
operators.frozen_operator: 2 sum_j Vj H_ij beta_sym +rho_water sum_j Vj(a_sj-a_si) dot(Ci grad_iW)
operators.role: Mismatched Morris scalar-head Laplacian plus receiver-C acceleration divergence; not labelled as candidate pair formulation

rate_equation: pdot_i=Kw/ni * [k/gamma_ref * frozen_operator -theta_i]. Main/raw pair frozen_operator=2 sum_j Vj R_ij beta_ij. g cancels ONCE through a_s=Ace+g; candidate has no additional legacy gravity lapz term.
pointwise_flux: Gp_i=sum_j Vj(pj-pi) Ci grad_iW; q_i=-k/gamma_ref[ Gp_i-rho_water(g-a_si) ]=-k/gamma_ref[ Gp_i+rho_water Ace_i ]. Compare actual affine Gp and nonzero physical q, not merely pdot=0.
fields: Affine accelerated-hydrostatic p with grad p=-rho_water Ace; g=0,-8,+8 and reversed Ace
Free fall with signed g=-8/+8: Ace0, physical a_s=g, pconstant; main pairR0 and physicalq0
Stationary hydrostatic with g=-8: Ace=-g, physical a_s0, gradp=rho_water*g; main pairR0 and physicalq0
Constant p plus constant nonzero Ace: physical q is constant nonzero, continuum divergence0; finite-cloud local rate defect is measured, NOT assumed zero
Quadratic pressure, Ace0,g0: frozen weighted budget and pure-pressure dissipation identity
Quadratic pressure plus affine all-component acceleration: continuum lap p+rho_water div Ace, core and outer errors separately
k0 compression,dilation,zero trace: prescribed theta=-1/32,+1/32,0, no claim of an actual velocity-gradient path

field_coverage.k0_only: Indices7,8,9 (compression,dilation,zero trace); appended freefall/hydrostatic retain nonzero k

gates.moment_rank: Positive moment determinant; no clamped/fallback inverse
gates.beta_sign: Raw and symmetric beta finite and <=0 for every reciprocal edge
gates.beta_reciprocity: Exactly equal under independently reversed edge directions
gates.frozen_weighted_Darcy_budget: abs(sum_i Vi ni/Kw DarcyRate_i)<=1024*DBL_EPSILON*sum_i abs(Vi ni/Kw DarcyRate_i)+1e-14 m^dimension/s, main and raw pair only
gates.compression_budget: Weighted total budget equals -sum Vi theta within the Darcy budget tolerance plus1e-14 m^dimension/s
gates.pure_pressure_identity: sum_i Vi ni/Kw pi pdot_i = 2k/gamma_ref sum_undirected ViVj(pi-pj)^2 beta_ij <=0, tolerance1024*DBL_EPSILON*absolute_energy_scale+1e-10 Pa*m^dimension/s, main/raw pair only
gates.continuum_accuracy: Diagnostic only: report core and outer RMS/max; no theory acceptance from this algebraic screen
gates.constant_flux_defect: Report symmetric-pair full-support-core max defect, even if nonzero; potential candidate-admission blocker for later review, not a blindly enforced zero gate

production_rate_overwrite: NOT tested or implemented here. Future actual production pass must poison its rate buffer before each stage, reset once and reproduce its independently assembled compression+Darcy rate. Standalone vector initialization is not that proof.
limitations: Frozen weighted pressure/storage and energy identities are NOT exact fluid-water mass conservation
Kernel and inverse APIs are production headers, but P3 rate assembly itself is standalone candidate algebra, not production ct
No physical trajectory, GPU, periodic-copy consistency, boundary conditions, nonzero-k state evolution or restart acceptance
No build/run or Git action before explicit root review
